model.name: strip.renderDescriptors
model.description: R31.5.2 (rb-strip foundation) — RbStrip.renderDescriptors(descriptors: StripDescriptor[]) accepts the ordered descriptor array and builds the ordered row (compartment -> hosts rb-compartment; bar -> hosts a bar element), diff/patching on re-set (idempotent, like rb-trace-tree items). Landscape flex-row is the DEFAULT here; the responsive scroll-snap MODE is R31.5.4 (applyViewportMode/observeContainer/focus-restore, SEPARATE chain on the same class). StripDescriptor.interface {id; kind:'compartment'|'bar'; content} is the layer3 data contract (NOT a chain Method). Singular-chain (#27/#38): ONE public method -> ONE UC. Architect topology commit 4729caa14.
